verdict.rationale: Warp's own API docs show an official standalone CLI binary installed from the TeamWarp Homebrew tap, so a first-party CLI exists. Its scope and agent-oriented usage are not documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and capabilities, auth/configuration docs for the CLI, evidence of AI-native or agent workflow use of the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote:
# Homebrew — standalone binary, no Node.js required
brew install TeamWarp/tap/warp
